frozen_candidate_root_contribution: To direct one's gaze/attention toward a designated object across a gap. In form I this is concretely realized as look-at (naZara ilaa a viewable thing), examine/consider (naZara + kayfa/maadhaa/fii, turning attention on evidence), watch-on/behold (absolute spectator posture), and await an anticipated event (hal/maa yanZuruuna illaa + an impending event); the derived form VIII (intaZara/muntaZir-) lexicalizes this same edge as free-standing await/wait-for. The bridge from perception to expectant regard is attested Quran-internally, not imposed. This account does NOT extend to the form-IV respite family (see resistant class).

internal_discovery.candidate_root_contribution: To direct one's gaze/attention toward a designated object across a gap. In form I this is concretely realized as look-at (naZara ilaa a viewable thing), examine/consider (naZara + kayfa/maadhaa/fii, turning attention on evidence), watch-on/behold (absolute spectator posture), and await an anticipated event (hal/maa yanZuruuna illaa + an impending event); the derived form VIII (intaZara/muntaZir-) lexicalizes this same edge as free-standing await/wait-for. The bridge from perception to expectant regard is attested Quran-internally, not imposed. This account does NOT extend to the form-IV respite family (see resistant class).
internal_discovery.plain_explanation: nZr is about aiming your attention at something, not about the result of seeing it. Depending on what you aim at, that becomes: looking at a present thing, examining evidence to consider how/what, watching a scene unfold, or waiting for something that is coming. Form VIII (intaZara) is just the settled word for wait. A separate branch, form IV (anZara) plus the form-I noun naZira in 2:280, means grant a delay / respite - giving someone time, not looking at them - and the Quran never links that meaning to seeing, so it stands apart.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: (1) nZr != achieved perception/sight (baSar/ru'yah): 7:198 they yanZuruuna toward you yet do not yubSiruun; 10:43 same; aspiration to gaze vs denied vision at 7:143 (anZur ilayka / lan taraanii). nZr aims the regard; baSar/ra'aa attains the image. (2) nZr does not entail favor/approval: it is neutral directed regard, becoming gracious regard only where relational context forces it (3:77, negated). (3) Form-I await is a specific oriented expectancy toward a named event, not endurance (Sabr). (4) Look does not entail grant-time: the respite sense is carried only by form IV and the lexicalized naZira, never by form-I looking; and form IV never means cause-to-look (the visual-causative slot is filled by r'y, e.g. arinii, 7:143).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 2:280 naZiratun (a deferment until ease) is a form-I nominal meaning respite with zero perceptual or attentional content, aligning with the form-IV respite class rather than the perception/attention nucleus. It is the cleanest internal proof that nZr does not reduce to one meaning even within form I, and it aligns with the whole form-IV respite class, which is materially unbridged to the perception nucleus.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: Two candidate rivals. (A) Monosemy allot-attention/regard-over-an-interval (looking = visual attention; await = attention toward a future arrival; respite = allot someone an interval). Rejected: it is the vague abstraction that fits everything and only absorbs the respite class through a barred look->time etymology; it fails the narrowest-account principle and the case where the respite-granter is oriented toward nothing. (B) Two fully unbridged nuclei - perception/attention (I+VIII) vs deferral (IV + naZira) - treating form-I unity as an artifact. This is the serious competitor; it is preferred over forced monosemy. We adopt a middle judgment: a form-I perception/attention nucleus cleanly bridged to form-VIII await (same yanZuru straddles look-at 2:259 and await 16:33; one participle naaZir- spans beholders 2:69 and waiters 33:53), with the respite family held as a RESISTANT, unbridged sub-class - hence REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE, not STRONG and not whole-root UNRESOLVED.
internal_discovery.competing_hypothesis: Two candidate rivals. (A) Monosemy allot-attention/regard-over-an-interval (looking = visual attention; await = attention toward a future arrival; respite = allot someone an interval). Rejected: it is the vague abstraction that fits everything and only absorbs the respite class through a barred look->time etymology; it fails the narrowest-account principle and the case where the respite-granter is oriented toward nothing. (B) Two fully unbridged nuclei - perception/attention (I+VIII) vs deferral (IV + naZira) - treating form-I unity as an artifact. This is the serious competitor; it is preferred over forced monosemy. We adopt a middle judgment: a form-I perception/attention nucleus cleanly bridged to form-VIII await (same yanZuru straddles look-at 2:259 and await 16:33; one participle naaZir- spans beholders 2:69 and waiters 33:53), with the respite family held as a RESISTANT, unbridged sub-class - hence REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE, not STRONG and not whole-root UNRESOLVED.
internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses converge: REPRESENTATIVE + MODERATE. The form-I perception/attention core, extended to form-VIII await, is broad, distinctive (sharp nZr != baSar boundary) and adversarially clean, and the look<->await bridge is internally demonstrated (6:158 places form-I hal-yanZuruuna await alongside form-VIII intaZiruu/muntaZiruun; 27:35 and 33:53 give a single participle straddling behold/await). But a coherent, morphologically-segregated, lexicalized RESISTANT sub-class exists - form IV grant-respite (18 occ.) plus the form-I nominal naZira 2:280 - whose object is time, not a percept, and which the Quran never bridges to looking (no co-occurrence, no gloss, only a barred etymological link). Per contract, a resistant lexicalized/nominal class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE. We do not force one nucleus (would violate narrowest-account) nor declare whole-root UNRESOLVED (the perception+await family is a genuine, well-attested PREFERRED claim); we scope the claim to that derivational family and mark the respite class resistant.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form I (base verb + form-I participles/masdars): direct the gaze/attention toward an object across a gap - look-at (naZara ilaa: 2:259, 88:17, 10:43), examine/consider how/what (naZara + kayfa/maadhaa/fii: 7:185, 27:27, 59:18, the dense unZur-kayfa-kaana-aaqibatu formula), watch-on/behold (2:50, 83:23; nominal naaZiriin beholders 2:69, 7:108; naZrah a-glance 37:88), and await an anticipated event (hal/maa yanZuruuna illaa: 16:33, 2:210, 6:158, 35:43, 36:49, 38:15, 43:66, 47:18, 7:53; imperatives unZurnaa/unZuruunaa 2:104, 4:46, 57:13; participles naaZir- awaiting 27:35, 33:53). One nucleus with an internally-attested perception->await bridge.
clusters.classification_rationale: Grouped by morphology (form-I verb and form-I nominal). The look<->await straddle occurs within this single form (same yanZuru, same ilaa/illaa framing, one participle spanning both), so the await sub-frame is a bridged extension, not a separate sense. EXCEPTION: 2:280 naZirapN is a form-I nominal meaning respite and is overridden to RESISTANT (see occurrence_overrides); 75:23 and 3:77 are adversarial boundaries held consistent.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Perception/attention core is broad and distinctive; nZr != baSar is explicit at 7:198 and 10:43. Await bridge attested at 6:158 (form-I hal-yanZuruuna beside form-VIII intaZiruu) and in the straddling participle 27:35/33:53.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form VIII (intaZara/yantaZiru/muntaZir-): free-standing await / wait-for. Every token = wait; none governs a viewable object (10:102 x3, 10:20, 11:122, 32:30, 33:23, 6:158, 7:71). Lexicalizes the expectant-regard edge of the form-I nucleus.
clusters.classification_rationale: A dedicated derived stem, but bridged to the core: 6:158 co-locates form-I await and this form-VIII await in one verse, so it is a lexicalized specialization of the perception/attention nucleus, not a separate root-sense.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Decisive bridge datum 6:158: hal yanZuruuna illaa ... qul intaZiruu innaa muntaZiruun - form I and form VIII of await side by side.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form IV (anZara/yunZaru/munZar-): grant respite / be reprieved / defer a term (7:14 anZirnii ilaa yawmi yub'athuun; munZariin those-reprieved 7:15, 15:37, 38:80, 44:29, 26:203, 15:8; wa-laa hum yunZaruun nor-are-they-given-respite 2:162, 3:88, 6:8, 16:85, 21:40, 32:29; laa tunZiruun 10:71, 11:55, 7:195). Object is an interval of time; subject bestows delay, does not perceive.
clusters.classification_rationale: Materially resistant, morphologically-segregated lexicalized class: the causative never means cause-to-look and no verse co-activates looking with respite. The only look->time link is diachronic/etymological, which SOURCE POLICY bars as authority. Held RESISTANT/unbridged to the perception nucleus; this is what caps the whole-root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: Form IV nZr (>anZir-/yunZaru/munZar-) denotes granting a temporal reprieve/respite: the object is an interval of time and the subject bestows delay rather than perceiving, with no visual or attentional content, and it never occurs in a make/let-look causative-of-perception sense, leaving it Quran-internally unbridged to the perception nucleus.

reconciliation.rationale: naZirapN = a granted deferral-period for an insolvent debtor, purely temporal with no perceptual content; it aligns with the form-IV respite class, so it is reclassified as a resistant leak of the deferral sense into a form-I nominal.
fa-naaZiratun bima yarji'u al-mursaluun = watching-for what the envoys return = await; retained as the internal bridge occurrence proving the look<->await extension within the perception nucleus.
ghayra naaZiriina inaahu = not awaiting its readiness; same participle as 2:69 beholders, confirming one form-I participle straddles behold/await - a bridge, not a break.
In the same verse form-VIII intaZiruu/muntaZiruun (6:158:35:1/37:1) glosses this form-I await, giving the decisive Quran-internal bridge between the form-I core and the form-VIII stem.

adversarial_verification.notes: A full adversarial refutation was not run to a SUPPORTED verdict because a coherent resistant sub-class (form-IV respite + 2:280) persists unbridged; the perception/attention+await core holds but is not claimed root-wide, so per contract the status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded rather than PASSED.

The only look->time link is diachronic/etymological, which SOURCE POLICY bars as authority. occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form IV (anZara/yunZaru/munZar-): grant respite / be reprieved / defer a term (7:14 anZirnii ilaa yawmi yub'athuun; munZariin those-reprieved 7:15, 15:37, 38:80, 44:29, 26:203, 15:8; wa-laa hum yunZaruun nor-are-they-given-respite 2:162, 3:88, 6:8, 16:85, 21:40, 32:29; laa tunZiruun 10:71, 11:55, 7:195). Object is an interval of time; subject bestows delay, does not perceive.

occurrence_dispositions.note: Materially resistant, morphologically-segregated lexicalized class: the causative never means cause-to-look and no verse co-activates looking with respite. The only look->time link is diachronic/etymological, which SOURCE POLICY bars as authority. Held RESISTANT/unbridged to the perception nucleus; this is what caps the whole-root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.

The only look->time link is diachronic/etymological, which SOURCE POLICY bars as authority. Held RESISTANT/unbridged to the perception nucleus; this is what caps the whole-root claim at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
occurrence_dispositions.candidate_semantic_interpretation: Form IV (anZara/yunZaru/munZar-): grant respite / be reprieved / defer a term (7:14 anZirnii ilaa yawmi yub'athuun; munZariin those-reprieved 7:15, 15:37, 38:80, 44:29, 26:203, 15:8; wa-laa hum yunZaruun nor-are-they-given-respite 2:162, 3:88, 6:8, 16:85, 21:40, 32:29; laa tunZiruun 10:71, 11:55, 7:195). Object is an interval of time; subject bestows delay, does not perceive.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A bottom-up, B sense-pole, C adversarial) all returned REPRESENTATIVE/MODERATE with the same resistant respite class; convergent but short of an adversarially clean root-wide SUPPORTED result.
candidate_root_contribution: To direct one's gaze/attention toward a designated object across a gap. In form I this is concretely realized as look-at (naZara ilaa a viewable thing), examine/consider (naZara + kayfa/maadhaa/fii, turning attention on evidence), watch-on/behold (absolute spectator posture), and await an anticipated event (hal/maa yanZuruuna illaa + an impending event); the derived form VIII (intaZara/muntaZir-) lexicalizes this same edge as free-standing await/wait-for. The bridge from perception to expectant regard is attested Quran-internally, not imposed. This account does NOT extend to the form-IV respite family (see resistant class).

layer_attribution.occurrence_evidence: 129 occurrences read in full: form-I look-at (2:259, 88:17, 10:43), examine (7:185, 27:27, unZur-kayfa formula), watch-on (2:50, 83:23), await (16:33, 6:158); form-VIII await (10:102, 7:71); form-IV respite (7:14, 2:162, 16:85); form-I nominal respite (2:280).
layer_attribution.derivation: Form VIII lexicalizes the expectant-regard edge of the form-I nucleus (await), bridged internally at 6:158; form IV lexicalizes a temporal-causative grant-respite that does NOT reduce to the perception nucleus and is held resistant.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: Resistant lexicalized class = form-IV respite family (anZir-/yunZaru/munZar-, 18 occ.) plus the form-I nominal naZira (2:280); object is time, not a percept.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Contextual colorings (divine gracious regard 3:77; blissful eschatological gazing 83:23; contested beatific vision 75:23) are narrative/relational and are NOT elevated into the root claim; the root contribution stays the neutral direct-the-gaze/attention.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Preliminary morphological placement of 2:280 in the form-I cluster was overturned to RESISTANT on occurrence semantics; the straddling participles 27:35/33:53 and the 6:158 pairing were retained as consistent bridge evidence rather than resistance.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The respite family (form IV + 2:280, 19 occ.) remains Quran-internally unbridged to the perception/attention nucleus; this is the standing resistance that caps the judgment at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE and blocks any STRONG root-wide unification.

hard_case_representation.rationale: All 18 form-IV occurrences plus the form-I nominal 2:280 constitute the resistant respite class and are represented as RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases with evidence_basis statements that recur verbatim as the strongest_counterexample (2:280) and the C3 form-IV cluster note (form-IV respite). 75:23 (contested gaze/await) and 3:77 (non-ocular divine regard) are ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY hard cases held consistent by either reading. Every final-RESISTANT occurrence is listed here and in counterevidence_refs.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quran-internal occurrence bridging the respite family to the perception nucleus - e.g. a form-IV token that means cause/let-[someone]-look/see, or a verse where a respite token (anZir-/yunZaru/munZar-/naZira 2:280) co-occurs with or is glossed by looking/examining - OR a form-I looking token that means grant-time. Such a find would collapse the REPRESENTATIVE scope into a single nucleus (or, conversely, split the form-I core itself).
rejection_condition.search_location: Form IV set (7:14, 15:36, 38:79, and the yunZaru/munZar-/tunZir- tokens 2:162, 3:88, 6:8, 16:85, 21:40, 32:29, 10:71, 11:55, 7:195, 7:15, 15:8, 15:37, 38:80, 44:29, 26:203) and 2:280:5:2, cross-checked against every form-I looking/examining context.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Re-read each candidate verse_text with QAC morphology; require the object/complement and the predication (perceiving vs bestowing-delay) to be settled from the verse alone, not from lexicon, tafsir, or etymology.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Reject any bridge that depends on the barred look->time etymology, on translation glosses, or on reading interval/orientation vaguely enough to cover both poles; the co-activation must be explicit in the Arabic.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If such a bridge is found, downgrade to a single nucleus (raise scope toward ROOT_GENERALIZATION) or, if it instead splits form I, move to UNRESOLVED_CLASS_ONLY; either way the current REPRESENTATIVE/DERIVATIONAL_FAMILY judgment is rejected.

reopen_conditions: Reopen if a form-IV token (e.g. 7:14 anZirnii, or any yunZaru/munZar- occurrence) is shown Quran-internally to carry perceptual/attentional content, or if 2:280 naZira is glossed by a looking context - this would bridge the respite class to the perception nucleus.

Reopen if the form-I look<->await bridge is broken - e.g. if 6:158 form-I/form-VIII pairing, or the straddling participle at 27:35/33:53, is reanalyzed so that form-I await and form-VIII await no longer share the nucleus, forcing a split of the currently-unified core.
Reopen if the contested 75:23 (ilaa rabbihaa naaZiratun) is resolved decisively toward await rather than gaze, shifting the weight of the form-I mass between the look and await sub-frames.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: A full adversarial refutation was not run to a SUPPORTED verdict because a coherent resistant sub-class (form-IV respite + 2:280) persists unbridged; the perception/attention+await core holds but is not claimed root-wide, so per contract the status is NOT_RUN with the resisting occurrences recorded rather than PASSED.
